column1: # Which source owns which skill concept. Policy, checked by scripts/doctor.
# This repo distributes and verifies skills. It does not own every concept.
# A concept owned elsewhere must not be re-implemented here: two skills that
# fire on the same situation collide in the host's skills directory, and
# whichever tool deployed last silently wins.
